claims_and_limits: Cached unexpired SDK tokens may be reused. Token callback counts are not server acceptance; actual authority token/introspection events and typed application dispatch are separate receipts.
Lifetime0 means reconnect, not KIP368 mid-connection reauthentication. Existing token-endpoint outage does not revoke a current valid key/introspection lease.
No arbitrary SDK stderr/exception strings are persisted; bounded stderr digest/count and safe typed stdout are retained.
Private keys, credentials and live bearer bytes stay in ephemeral0700/0600 scratch or memory. Third-party SDK/HTTP/JSON copies are not claimed fully zeroized.
OS DNS/file system calls are counted/bounded in admission but not forcibly cancellable. Process deadline fallback is recorded as a failed graceful join, not a successful ownership proof.
Template placeholder hashes are not proof. Final inputs require exact immutable source/runtime/JAR/library/build bindings and all losing outcomes retained.

The outer owner starts the driver in its own process group. Its300s total deadline includes reserved cleanup; no planned wait extends that deadline. Noncancellable Linux proc/signal/exec/wait calls may overrun, and any observed overrun fails. Forced TERM/KILL, surviving groups/readers or unresolved ownership fail. Core0 and Popen umask are inherited without post-fork Python callbacks.

origin_receipt_schema.original_materialization_receipt: hash-bound source audit proof, not a self-asserted placeholder

peer_build_receipt_schema.runtime_inputs: identical full path/hash list from configuration; Java must include all JAR/class/runtime inputs; native/Rust executable/runtime input set

negative_verdict_contract: Prior positive on the same configured peer; exactly one active peer; safe Java exception/native code/Rust Error category; actual authority outage/revocation/active-peer expiry/key-replacement witness; later positive recovery. Independent stdout readers provide no synchronized per-operation dispatch barrier; joined raw audit totals are retained and precise denial remains separately source-pinned core socket proof. A timeout is not itself called an authentication error.
unexpected_failure_contract: Retain safe failure_stage enum and failed_step index; do not persist arbitrary exception/provider message text.
cleanup_contract: Started-state tracked before issuer shutdown; every stop/close independently bounded with tracked non-daemon threads. Every owned process group is inspected even after leader exit, all pipe readers join, and forced cleanup invalidates graceful ownership.
external_owner_gate: Actual own-live.py Linux subreaper owner:100ms descendant plus PID/starttime-bound atomic registry tracking; absolute total300s including reserved cleanup; controlled driver TERM; independent guarded confirmed-session TERM/KILL sweeps before driver SIGKILL; adopted zombie reaping. Forced/surviving/unverified/overrun results fail. Six actual process controls and five separate stdlib/file/proc/pipe/Git controls qualify infrastructure only, including observation-fault and tiny-total-deadline controls. No OAuth/SDK result is inferred.
signed_policy_recipe: Each signed negative uses a stopped/fresh same-configured peer after its prior positive baseline, with actual token_policy control set before restart. Witness binds only newly minted hashes since fresh peer start. Recover with valid policy and another fresh peer. Client-local JWT rejection is distinct from observed broker-authentication class/code.
